proof.universe: Only plain horizon LP variables are reduced. Original document, original indices/count, rank weights and answerFrom reporting are retained.
proof.protected: Held, sell-lot, explicit protected/pinned IDs are excluded as both removal targets and replacement candidates; grandfathered club states fail closed.
proof.dominance: Same position, no greater buy price, every week's squad/starter/captain coefficient no smaller, and earlier original rank. Strict rank order prevents cycles.
proof.bound: T=policy transfer cap times weeks, B=T-1. A noninitial p needs a purchase. Each full non-p club c needs deficit d_c=max(0,C-initialHeld_c) distinct new purchases. Held replacement candidates outside those clubs spend the remaining B-sum(d_c) purchases. Bad candidates are at most B+max_{sum(d_c)<=B}sum(q_count_c-d_c).
proof.dynamic_program: 0/1 club knapsack, empty set profit0, negative-profit clubs optional, zero-cost clubs counted once from previous state. p's own club is exempt.
proof.swap: Choose a dominator absent from the entire initial/window squad union and never blocked by a full non-p club. Copy exactly p's held/lineup/captain/buy/sell bits. Transfer counts, hits and FT flow stay identical; bank increases by the nonnegative price difference while held. Primary cannot worsen, and an equal primary improves an original lexicographic rank tier.
proof.preserved_solution: No full lexicographic optimum contains a removed player. All removed players can therefore be omitted together.
proof.moves: Compared only where uniqueness was certified.
